parents.name: The Provider
parents.text: Works long hours, shows love through paying for things, rarely says it. Praise is a nod. Absence is the weather.

parents.name: The Anxious Protector
parents.text: Checks in constantly, narrates danger, holds too tight. You learn to manage their fear before your own.

parents.name: The Golden-Child Maker
parents.text: Tells everyone you are gifted. Love arrives with a report card. Failure feels like a betrayal of the family story.

parents.name: The Absent One
parents.text: Left, or was there and not there. A photo, a birthday call, a chair. You build a version of them to talk to.

parents.name: The Friend
parents.text: Treats you like an equal too early. You hear about money and heartbreak at nine. You become the adult in the room.

parents.name: The Immigrant Striver
parents.text: Two jobs, one language at home, another at the door. You translate forms at eight. Sacrifice is the family currency.

parents.name: The Warm Constant
parents.text: Predictable, present, dinner at six. Feelings are allowed. You do not remember it as remarkable, which is the point.

parents.name: The Storm
parents.text: Moods run the house. You read the front door closing like a barometer. You become very good at reading rooms.

schools.name: Suburban Public School
schools.text: Yellow buses, standardized tests, a gifted track and a lunch table that decides your rank.

schools.name: Small Religious School
schools.text: Uniforms, chapel, one teacher who knew your whole family. Shame and belonging arrive together.

schools.name: Underfunded Urban School
schools.text: Metal detectors, one great teacher who stayed, a library that closed at three. You learned to be sharp early.

schools.name: Elite Private School
schools.text: Ivy on the brochure, everyone's parent is someone. You learned what money sounds like when it is quiet.

schools.name: Rural Consolidated School
schools.text: Forty-minute bus, everyone since kindergarten, football on Friday. Leaving was the plan or the sin.

events.name: One adult saw you
events.text: A teacher or coach or neighbor said one sentence that you are still living up to.

events.name: Early responsibility
events.text: You raised a sibling, ran the house, or held the family together before you were twelve.

events.name: The move
events.text: A city, a country, a language. You arrived as the new kid and never fully unpacked.

events.name: Praise for one trait
events.text: Smart. Pretty. Strong. Funny. You became the trait and hid the rest.

events.name: The rupture
events.text: Divorce, a death, a departure. The house had a before and an after.

events.name: Public humiliation
events.text: One moment in front of everyone. You decided something about visibility that day.

events.name: First thing you loved alone
events.text: A book, a game, a sky. Nobody gave it to you and nobody could take it.

events.name: Money went away
events.text: A layoff, a lost house, a quiet downgrade. You learned to notice prices.

events.name: The secret
events.text: Something in the family nobody said out loud. You learned to hold what could not be held.

events.name: Being the translator
events.text: Between languages, between parents, between worlds. You became the bridge.

events.name: The win
events.text: A trophy, a scholarship, a stage. For one day the family story was about you and it was good.

events.name: The illness
events.text: Yours or theirs. Hospitals, waiting rooms, learning that bodies can fail.

events.name: The friend who left
events.text: The first person you chose who chose someone else.

events.name: Caught and forgiven
events.text: You did the wrong thing, got caught, and someone loved you anyway. You learned repair is possible.

events.name: Caught and shamed
events.text: You did the wrong thing and it became who you were for a year. You learned to hide.

events.name: The long summer alone
events.text: Weeks with no one home. You built a world to live in.

events.name: The grandparent
events.text: One older person who had time. Their kitchen was the safest room in the world.

events.name: The comparison
events.text: A sibling or cousin who was the standard. You measured yourself in someone else's units.

events.name: The first no
events.text: You refused something everyone expected. It cost you and it made you.

events.name: Being needed
events.text: Someone relied on you and you liked it more than you should have. Usefulness became love.
